d: Is the world’s most powerful oil cartel losing its grip on global energy? For nearly 50 years, OPEC dictated crude supply, manipulated oil prices, and moved the global economy from closed-door meetings in Vienna. In 1973, OPEC controlled over 50% of the world's crude oil supply. Today, its direct share has dropped toward 35%, while non-OPEC nations produce nearly 65% of the world’s oil.
